## Objective

Publish the checked Template and prove its starter behavior in disposable projects.

## Scope

- Updater and mapping changes
- Initializer and receipt compatibility
- Reviewed Template apply
- New and existing-project fixtures

## Entry conditions

- Source checks pass and exact Template adoption/migration authority covers the reviewed manifest.

## Exit criteria

- Template reports current; fresh and preserved existing-project fixtures validate with no live-state leakage.

## Risks

- The live registry is preserved by using disposable depot fixtures; destination customization blocks automatic overwrite.
